decisions.reason: Bleaching tray blanks build directly on the firm's core thermoforming material know-how, and lab feedback is easy to interpret and act on, so the firm keeps the line despite limited recent website visibility.
PETG thermoforming blanks sit squarely within the firm's established thermoforming competence and in-house R&D, making them a low-risk staple consumable worth keeping.

The UV-curing lacquer relates to the firm's light-curing expertise but remains a niche consumable with weak visibility, so it carries a moderate risk of consolidation, though related knowledge still favours keeping it.
Custom earmolds are a core competence of the hearing-care business, built on skilled custom-device manufacturing and digital production, so the firm absorbs market feedback well and keeps the line.
Custom hearing protection uses the same earmold know-how and digital workflows in an adjacent market the firm understands, so it remains worth keeping.
